senses.gloss: f. pl. (an adapt. of ἐπιστύλια, as if a reduplic. of פָּסַל) lintels on the top of a pillar, epistyles.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 1:1:14">Y. Succ. I, 52ᵃ</cite> bot. [read:] <he>ארבעה עמודים ועליהם ארבע פ׳</he> (Mus. <he>אפיס׳</he>) four columns and on top of them four epistyles (extending beyond the columns); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 1:9:6">Y. Erub. I, 19ᶜ</cite> <he>פִּצְטַלְיוֹת</he>.
